03Breakdown

Where the units came from

By sport, all 297 settled plays
SportPlaysW-L-P Units, drawn from zeroUnitsROI

All 297 settled plays. ROI is units won over units risked; pushes count as risked, voids do not. Rows marked † have fewer than 10 plays: read them as a record, not a rate.

A losing win rate can still be a winning record.

Not every bet pays the same. The price decides how often a play has to land just to break even:

At −110
52.4% to break even
At +150
40.0% to break even

So the win rate on its own says very little. ROI is the number that counts.
